body:
## [3.58.4] - 2026-07-30

### Bug Fixes

- enhance budget handling in multipass dialogs
- update required addon version to 19.0.3.58.3 and increment app version to 3.58.3
- preserve quick customer selection
- preserve general item prices on customer change

### Other Changes

- Implement change rounding adjustments and enhance payment matching logic for multi-currency transactions
- Add localized error message for no amount charged in multipass payment
- Refactor MultipassPaymentDialog for improved readability and error handling
- Enhance currency handling and payment processing logic
- Remove multipass insufficient budget confirmation feature and related localization keys
